title.en: Breadth-first search and shortest edge counts

summary: Expose discovery order, the FIFO queue and shortest paths on a small unweighted graph.
objective: Build a layered graph where I can single-step BFS and inspect its queue, distance labels and predecessor path.
intent_signals: Build a layered graph where I can single-step BFS and inspect its queue, distance labels and predecessor path.
Expose discovery order, the FIFO queue and shortest paths on a small unweighted graph.
example_prompts: Build a layered graph where I can single-step BFS and inspect its queue, distance labels and predecessor path.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of breadth first search with path inspector.
negative_signals: No weighted shortest-path guarantee; visual edge length is not a cost.
not_for: No weighted shortest-path guarantee; visual edge length is not a cost.

entities.name: Graph nodes and edges
entities.guidance: Lay out a small authored graph in depth layers, routing crossings clearly without inventing junctions; include a cycle and a disconnected vertex.

entities.name: Queue rail
entities.guidance: Show the front and back of the FIFO queue as ordered slots carrying vertex IDs, not copies of graph state.

entities.name: Path inspector
entities.guidance: Select a vertex to show its predecessor chain, edge count or unreachable state; use edge thickness and text as well as discovery color.

state_contract.model: Finite unweighted undirected graph with stable vertex IDs and deterministic neighbor order. Mark vertices when enqueued; assign distance[parent]+1 at first discovery.
state_contract.authority: An executable BFS state or recorded verified trace owns queue, discovered set, distances and predecessors; spatial layout never determines graph adjacency.
actions: Pause or replay the immutable trace.
Reset or edit graph, invalidating the old trace.

invariants: A vertex is enqueued at most once.
Every predecessor chain reaches the source and has the displayed distance; disconnected vertices remain unreachable.
motion_guidance: Animate one semantic event at a time and highlight the exact inspected edge.
Force-directed layout motion must not consume algorithm steps or change IDs.
known_limits: No weighted shortest-path guarantee; visual edge length is not a cost.
Different neighbor ordering can choose a different equal-length predecessor tree.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Breadth-first search uses a FIFO queue to find paths with minimum edge count from a source in an unweighted graph.
claims.scope: Minimum edge count, not Euclidean length or weighted cost.

object_craft.structure: Lay out a small authored graph in depth layers, routing crossings clearly without inventing junctions; include a cycle and a disconnected vertex.
object_craft.material: Solid labeled nodes, subdued unvisited edges and explicit queue direction; ghost tokens in the queue reference the same stable IDs.
